reviewMethod: Direct view_image detail=original of full untouched images, same-layout head/ears/eye contours/lips/scalp compared; PIL used only for read-only full decode/dimension/mode; no crop, resize, retouch or imagery written. Encoding parameters were not read before visual conclusions.
sourceIntegrity: Expected source SHA256 matches; all three decode as2048x2048 RGB.

observations.layout: Both candidates retain visible head silhouette and ear/eye/lip/scalp landmarks at the same original atlas positions; no visible flip, rotation, crop or offset.
observations.scalp: Fine stubble pattern remains legible in both. Slight smoothing of fine grain relative to source is plausible/visible at inspection, but no obvious block grid or large blotches in the compared head regions.
observations.ears: Outer ear contours and dark inner folds retain their structure; no blocking halo or color bleed identified at the reviewed display scale.
observations.eyeContours: Dark eye corners and lid color gradients remain distinguishable. Separate red eye-related chart interiors preserve their shapes. This does not verify rendered eyeballs.
observations.lips: Pink lips, small center highlight/slit and nearby nostril shading remain recognizable and spatially aligned. The thin bright center mark also exists in the source, so it is not classified as a new codec artifact.
observations.bVersusG: No reliable visual winner for head fidelity from this direct full2048 inspection. Both have small texture changes from the PNG; neither is claimed pixel-identical.
observations.blockingCodecArtifacts: No blocking head-region artifact identified in b or g at reviewed display scale.

decision: Both b and g are visually eligible for the next bounded integration comparison. Choose final encoding with parent quantitative masked error/bytes evidence; this review alone does not establish a superiority ranking.
boundaries: Only b and g reviewed after parent narrowed request; c/d were not reviewed.
This is a source-asset codec inspection, not a rendered skin or game-screen comparison.
No MIP/filtering/seam/flipY/material tint/mobile GPU test performed.
No PS4-quality claim or blanket all-pixel absence-of-artifact claim.
